data: What types of data were used to produce the ASR results in Figure 4?

The caption states that the ASR results in Figure 4 were produced with an updated Language Model (LM) and vocabulary. The lines in the graph represent two different datasets: one labeled "Sup/RS + Unsup" and the other labeled "Sup/AL + Unsup." These labels indicate the types of data used for training. Therefore, the data used to produce the ASR results in Figure 4 includes supervised data with RS and unsupervised data, as well as supervised data with AL and unsupervised data.
